classification.difficultyReason: Converts defining rules to listed elements, including domain restrictions and two-integer expressions.

questions.methodNote: Use the defining domain and expression to list distinct elements. Natural numbers begin at 1. Page 3 Example 3 demonstrates integer patterns, powers, equation-defined sets and empty sets.
